backend/main.mo: Main actor for the ICP backend managing user profiles, admin access control, logger ID labels, and ConceptMachine visibility, with query/update methods gated by role checks.
backend/migration.mo: Defines a migration function that upgrades actor state from OldActor to NewActor by adding the new loggerIdLoggerLabels map field.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking two implemented features—admin-only editable TSIC logger ID labels UI and corresponding React Query hooks—to their source files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short summaries of all frontend source files, describing their roles in the application for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based design tokens for light and dark themes including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar color variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell with title 'Conceptmachine Live Data' that mounts the React app via the root div and main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component implementing default-deny admin access gating, ConceptMachine visibility filtering, page navigation, and conditional Google Sheets download URL passing to the title bar.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: UI component that displays either a loading spinner while checking admin permissions or an access-denied card with a profile navigation button.
frontend/src/components/AuthControls.tsx: Empty file with no content, likely a placeholder for authentication control components.
frontend/src/components/CO2Chart.tsx: A Recharts-based line chart component displaying CO2 sensor data (right, left, CSV) with drag-to-zoom, brush range selection, and auto-zoom to the last 24 hours on initial load.
frontend/src/components/CoolingHeatingVe: A Recharts line chart showing cooling, heating, and ventilation percentages (derived from raw voltage/PWM values) with drag-to-zoom, brush range selection, and auto-zoom to the last 24 hours.
frontend/src/components/DashboardCard.ts: A reusable card layout component with a styled header (title + optional action) and content area, built on top of shadcn/ui Card primitives.
frontend/src/components/FanVoltageFlowCo: A dual-Y-axis Recharts line chart displaying fan voltages (fan1V, fan2V, fan3V) and flow control pressure (Pa) with drag-to-zoom, brush range selection, and auto-zoom to the last 24 hours.
frontend/src/components/LogSystemTitleBa: A responsive title bar for log system pages featuring navigation arrows, theme toggle, refresh, admin download button, profile menu, and a mobile sheet menu with sign-out and principal copy functionality.
frontend/src/components/ProfileMenu.tsx: A dropdown menu component for authenticated users that displays their name and truncated principal, and provides options to copy the principal, navigate to the account page, or sign out.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that prompts newly authenticated users to enter their name and save their profile, blocking interaction until the form is submitted.
frontend/src/components/TemperatureChart: A Recharts line chart component for displaying filtered and CSV temperature data with drag-to-zoom, brush range selection, and auto-zoom to the last 24 hours on first load.
A Recharts-based line chart component for displaying up to 72 TSIC sensor temperature readings with features including drag-to-zoom, brush range selection, per-sensor visibility toggles, and auto-zoom to the last 24 hours on initial load.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React Query hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor, using an authenticated identity when available or falling back to anonymous, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminList.ts: A React Query hook that fetches the list of all admins from the backend actor, enabled only when the caller is confirmed as an admin.
frontend/src/hooks/useConceptMachineVisi: Provides two hooks: one to query the ConceptMachine page visibility from the backend, and a mutation hook to update that visibility setting (admin-only).
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: A React Query hook that fetches the current caller's user profile from the backend actor, returning null on authorization errors.
A hook that subscribes to the React Query cache and returns a formatted timestamp string reflecting when the 'temperature-series' query was last updated.
frontend/src/hooks/useGoogleSheetsDownlo: A React Query hook that fetches and indefinitely caches the Google Sheets download link from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context provider and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, managing login, logout, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: A React Query hook that checks whether the current caller has admin privileges via the backend actor, defaulting to false on any error.
frontend/src/hooks/useLogSystemNavigatio: A hook managing navigation state (current index, next/previous/go-to) across a list of log system pages defined in logSystemPages.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports mutation hooks for saving a user profile and granting admin roles via the backend actor, with cache invalidation on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSyncedTimeWindow.t: Custom hook that manages a shared time window (zoom range) for charts, providing setRange, resetZoom, and a clamped visibleRange derived from dataLength.
React Query hook that fetches temperature/CO2 series data with manual-only refresh, also tracking the last successful update timestamp.
frontend/src/hooks/useThemeSession.ts: Hook that persists light/dark theme preference to sessionStorage and synchronizes the document's dark class with the current state.
frontend/src/hooks/useTSICData.ts: React Query hook that fetches TSIC sensor data for a given logger ID, with manual-only refresh and infinite stale time.
frontend/src/hooks/useTSICLabels.ts: Provides a query hook to fetch all TSIC logger ID-to-label mappings (admin-only) and a mutation hook to save a label for a specific logger ID.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including color tokens for UI elements and chart series.
frontend/src/lib/temperatureDataSource.t: Fetches raw temperature and CO2 JSON data from a Google Apps Script endpoint and delegates parsing to temperatureParsing, throwing on invalid responses.
frontend/src/lib/temperatureParsing.ts: Parses raw API data into typed TemperatureDataPoint objects, handling comma-decimal strings, DD/MM/YY timestamps, and optional sensor fields like cooling and fan voltages.
frontend/src/lib/tsicDataParsing.ts: Parses raw TSIC logger JSON into TSICDataPoint objects with a timestamp and 72 sensor readings (S1–S72), sorting results by timestamp.
frontend/src/lib/tsicDataSource.ts: Fetches TSIC sensor data for a given logger ID from a Google Apps Script endpoint and delegates parsing to tsicDataParsing.
frontend/src/logSystems/logSystemPages.t: Defines the list of navigable log system pages (Conceptmachine, TSIC Loggers, Profile) with their IDs, display names, subtitles, and page components.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page component that renders an Internet Identity sign-in button with loading and error states using shadcn UI primitives.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: React page for user profile management, allowing users to edit their name, copy their principal, and (if admin) grant admin rights to other principals and manage the admin list and concept machine visibility toggle.
frontend/src/pages/TemperatureDashboardP: Dashboard page that fetches and displays temperature, CO2, cooling/heating/ventilation, and fan voltage/flow data as charts with synced time-window zoom and date range filtering controls.
frontend/src/pages/TSICLogger1Page.tsx: Empty file with no content, likely a placeholder for a single TSIC logger detail page.
frontend/src/pages/TSICLoggersPage.tsx: Page displaying TSIC sensor logger data with selectable logger ID buttons, synced time-window zoom/pan controls, date range filtering, and an admin-only inline label editor (LoggerIdLabelEditor) for each logger ID.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read, persist, and clear URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback for cross-navigation persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, extended typography/font families, border radii, box shadows, and accordion keyframe animations, using the typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing the ConceptMachine app's current version, architectural notes, known issues, existing features, and pending feature requests — specifically around adding admin-only persistent editable labels for TSIC Logger ID buttons on both frontend and backend.
